alignments.note: Causal כִּי rendered by the ASV's clause-initial *For*.
Proper name.
Construct noun keeps only its own word; the relational *of* goes to the rectum by rule 19.
Nomen rectum takes the construct relation's *of*, headed on the name by rule 24.

Hiphil רוּם 'contribute as offering' is rendered by the light verb *did give* plus the complement *for offerings*; by rule 44 the head is the complement, since *give* alone gives anything while *offerings* carries the lexeme. The unit is discontinuous around *to the assembly* under rule 25. Competing reading: treat *for offerings* as an `added` supply and head the verb on *give* — rejected because the parallel clause renders the same verb bare (*the princes gave*), which is exactly the rendering that loses the offering sense.
Preposition לְ → *to* by rule 11.
Article assimilated into the pointed preposition is still a token and takes the written *the* (rule 12).

Numeral with the indefinite article, which belongs to the nominal expression under rule 15 and is never the head.
Counted noun.
Waw → *and*; the phrase's waws and the ASV's *and*s match one for one, so rule 42 marks nothing.

Assimilated article token takes the written *the* (rule 12).

Numeral with its indefinite article; English reorders the numeral before the counted noun.
Counted noun, reordered after its numeral in English (rule 25).

Numeral, reordered before the counted noun in English.
Numeral.
Counted noun, which Hebrew writes before its numeral and English after it.
Waw of the consecutive form takes *and*; the verb takes the verb (rule 14).

רֹב 'abundance' rendered by the multi-word phrase *a great number*; by rule 31's subtraction the head is *great*, since *number* alone is any number while *great* carries the lexeme of muchness, as *high place* heads on *high*. The ASV never writes a bare *number* for רֹב, and 30.5 renders the same word *great numbers* on the same footing. The indefinite article joins the nominal expression under rule 15. The competing reading heads on the noun *number*.

The adverbial לָרֹב is recast as a quantifying phrase over the clause's subject, and the ASV writes no English word for the preposition's own relation, so it is `unrepresented` under rule 40 — exactly as the same phrase is read at 30.13, *a very great assembly*. Where that relation is written the preposition takes the word, as at 30.5, *in great numbers*. Competing reading: give the *of* of *a great number of priests* to this לְ — declined because that *of* stands before כֹהֲנִים and states what that nominal contributes, which is rule 33's word, while the לְ governs רֹב and not כֹהֲנִים; by rule 40's subtraction, dropping it breaks the English quantifier rather than leaving this preposition's relation unstated. Contrast 30.22, where לַיהוָה → *of Jehovah* keeps the *of* on the preposition, which there governs the very name it introduces.

Bare noun with no preposition and no object marker on it, before which the ASV writes an *of* stating what the nominal contributes to the quantity; the word is this noun's own rendering under rule 33 and goes to the word it stands before. The head stays on the word carrying the lexeme, the supplied preposition never being the head (rules 24, 33).
Hithpael verb; the reflexive *themselves* renders the verb's own voice and stays in its unit under rule 44, headed on the lexical verb.

review_notes: Waws and English *and*s balance one for one across the two numeral runs, so rule 42 marks nothing on either side.
Both assimilated article tokens ([הַ] after לַ) take a written *the* under rule 12.
*for offerings* is taken as the complement of the first הֵרִים under rule 44 rather than `added`, and the unit heads on *offerings*.

Reconciliation change: the *of* of *a great number of priests* moves from the לְ to כֹהֲנִים under rule 33, and the לְ goes `unrepresented` under rule 40, so that this chapter's three occurrences of לָרֹב agree — the preposition takes an English word only where the ASV writes one for its own adverbial relation (30.5 *in*), and none where the phrase is recast as a nominal quantifier (30.13, 30.24).
